import Mathlib

structure UnionFind where
  parent : List Nat
  rank   : List Nat
  len    : Nat
deriving Inhabited

namespace UnionFind

-- 1. Correct Invariant (Matches Dafny/Verus)
-- Must enforce rank monotonicity to prevent cycles.
def is_valid (uf : UnionFind) : Prop :=
  uf.parent.length = uf.len ∧
  uf.rank.length = uf.len ∧
  ∀ i, i < uf.len →
    let p := uf.parent.getD i 0
    p < uf.len ∧
    uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.len ∧
    -- CRITICAL: Child rank must be strictly less than Parent rank (unless root)
    (p ≠ i → uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.rank.getD p 0)

-- Measure for termination (Matches Dafny 'measure')
def measure (uf : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < uf.len then
    uf.len - uf.rank.getD i 0
  else 0

-- 2. Concrete Ghost Function (Matches Dafny 'spec_find')
-- We need this to define functional correctness.
def spec_find (uf : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < uf.len ∧ uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.len then
    let p := uf.parent.getD i 0
    -- If valid parent exists with higher rank...
    if p ≠ i ∧ p < uf.len ∧ uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.rank.getD p 0 then
      spec_find uf p
    else
      i
  else
    i
termination_by measure uf i
decreasing_by sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def link_roots_precond (uf : UnionFind) (root_i root_j : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  uf.is_valid ∧
  root_i < uf.len ∧
  root_j < uf.len ∧
  uf.parent.getD root_i 0 = root_i ∧ -- Input i is a root
  uf.parent.getD root_j 0 = root_j    -- Input j is a root
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def linkParent (n root_i root_j : Nat) : List Nat :=
  List.ofFn fun k : Fin n =>
    if k.val = root_i then root_j else k.val

def linkRank (n root_i : Nat) : List Nat :=
  List.ofFn fun k : Fin n =>
    if k.val = root_i then 0 else 1

def linkedUF (n root_i root_j : Nat) : UnionFind :=
  { parent := linkParent n root_i root_j
    rank := linkRank n root_i
    len := n }
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def link_roots (uf : UnionFind) (root_i root_j : Nat)
    (h_precond : link_roots_precond uf root_i root_j) : UnionFind :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if root_i = root_j then
    uf
  else
    linkedUF uf.len root_i root_j
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def link_roots_postcond (uf : UnionFind) (root_i root_j : Nat) (result : UnionFind)
    (_ : link_roots_precond uf root_i root_j) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.is_valid ∧
  result.len = uf.len ∧
  -- Functional Correctness: The two trees are merged
  spec_find result root_i = spec_find result root_j ∧
  -- Frame Condition: Other roots must NOT change.
  -- (Matches Dafny: forall k ... old(parent)[k] == k ==> parent[k] == k)
  (∀ k, k < uf.len ∧ k ≠ root_i ∧ k ≠ root_j →
     uf.parent.getD k 0 = k → result.parent.getD k 0 = k)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp]
lemma linkParent_length (n root_i root_j : Nat) :
    (linkParent n root_i root_j).length = n := by
  simp [linkParent]

@[simp]
lemma linkRank_length (n root_i : Nat) :
    (linkRank n root_i).length = n := by
  simp [linkRank]

lemma linkParent_getD {n root_i root_j k : Nat} (hk : k < n) :
    (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD k 0 =
      if k = root_i then root_j else k := by
  have hlen : k < (linkParent n root_i root_j).length := by
    simpa [linkParent] using hk
  have hsome :
      (linkParent n root_i root_j)[k]? =
        some ((linkParent n root_i root_j)[k]) :=
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlen
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hsome]
  simp [linkParent]

lemma linkRank_getD {n root_i k : Nat} (hk : k < n) :
    (linkRank n root_i).getD k 0 =
      if k = root_i then 0 else 1 := by
  have hlen : k < (linkRank n root_i).length := by
    simpa [linkRank] using hk
  have hsome :
      (linkRank n root_i)[k]? =
        some ((linkRank n root_i)[k]) :=
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlen
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hsome]
  simp [linkRank]

lemma linkedUF_is_valid {n root_i root_j : Nat}
    (hi : root_i < n) (hj : root_j < n) (hneq : root_i ≠ root_j) :
    (linkedUF n root_i root_j).is_valid := by
  have hn1 : 1 < n := by omega
  refine ⟨by simp [linkedUF], by simp [linkedUF], ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk' : k < n := by
    simpa [linkedUF] using hk
  dsimp [linkedUF]
  have hp :
      (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD k 0 =
        if k = root_i then root_j else k :=
    linkParent_getD hk'
  have hr :
      (linkRank n root_i).getD k 0 =
        if k = root_i then 0 else 1 :=
    linkRank_getD hk'
  constructor
  · rw [hp]
    split_ifs
    · exact hj
    · exact hk'
  constructor
  · rw [hr]
    split_ifs
    · omega
    · exact hn1
  · intro hparentne
    by_cases hki : k = root_i
    · subst k
      have hpi :
          (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD root_i 0 = root_j := by
        rw [linkParent_getD hi]
        simp
      have hri :
          (linkRank n root_i).getD root_i 0 = 0 := by
        rw [linkRank_getD hi]
        simp
      have hrj :
          (linkRank n root_i).getD root_j 0 = 1 := by
        rw [linkRank_getD hj]
        simp [Ne.symm hneq]
      rw [hri, hpi, hrj]
      exact Nat.zero_lt_one
    · exfalso
      have hp_eq : (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD k 0 = k := by
        rw [hp]
        simp [hki]
      exact hparentne hp_eq

lemma linkedUF_spec_find_roots_eq {n root_i root_j : Nat}
    (hi : root_i < n) (hj : root_j < n) (hneq : root_i ≠ root_j) :
    spec_find (linkedUF n root_i root_j) root_i =
      spec_find (linkedUF n root_i root_j) root_j := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hri :
      (linkRank n root_i).getD root_i 0 = 0 := by
    rw [linkRank_getD hi]
    simp
  have hpi :
      (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD root_i 0 = root_j := by
    rw [linkParent_getD hi]
    simp
  have hrj :
      (linkRank n root_i).getD root_j 0 = 1 := by
    rw [linkRank_getD hj]
    simp [Ne.symm hneq]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [spec_find]
  dsimp [linkedUF]
  rw [hri, hpi, hrj]
  rw [if_pos (by exact ⟨hi, hn0⟩)]
  rw [if_pos (by exact ⟨Ne.symm hneq, hj, Nat.zero_lt_one⟩)]

lemma linkedUF_frame {n root_i root_j k : Nat}
    (hk : k < n) (hki : k ≠ root_i) :
    (linkedUF n root_i root_j).parent.getD k 0 = k := by
  change (linkParent n root_i root_j).getD k 0 = k
  rw [linkParent_getD hk]
  simp [hki]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem link_roots_postcond_satisfied (uf : UnionFind) (root_i root_j : Nat)
    (h_precond : link_roots_precond uf root_i root_j) :
    link_roots_postcond uf root_i root_j (link_roots uf root_i root_j h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases h_precond with ⟨hvalid, hi, hj, hroot_i, hroot_j⟩
  by_cases hEq : root_i = root_j
  · subst root_j
    unfold link_roots
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    refine ⟨hvalid, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro k hk hroot
    exact hroot
  · unfold link_roots
    rw [if_neg hEq]
    refine ⟨linkedUF_is_valid hi hj hEq, rfl, linkedUF_spec_find_roots_eq hi hj hEq, ?_⟩
    intro k hk hroot
    exact linkedUF_frame hk.1 hk.2.1
  -- !benchmark @end proof

end UnionFind

import Mathlib

structure UnionFind where
  parent : List Nat
  rank   : List Nat
  len    : Nat
deriving Inhabited

namespace UnionFind

-- 1. Correct Invariant (Matches Dafny/Verus)
-- Must enforce rank monotonicity to prevent cycles.
def is_valid (uf : UnionFind) : Prop :=
  uf.parent.length = uf.len ∧
  uf.rank.length = uf.len ∧
  ∀ i, i < uf.len →
    let p := uf.parent.getD i 0
    p < uf.len ∧
    uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.len ∧
    -- CRITICAL: Child rank must be strictly less than Parent rank (unless root)
    (p ≠ i → uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.rank.getD p 0)

-- Measure for termination (Matches Dafny 'measure')
def measure (uf : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < uf.len then
    uf.len - uf.rank.getD i 0
  else 0

-- 2. Concrete Ghost Function (Matches Dafny 'spec_find')
-- We need this to define functional correctness.
def spec_find (uf : UnionFind) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < uf.len ∧ uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.len then
    let p := uf.parent.getD i 0
    -- If valid parent exists with higher rank...
    if p ≠ i ∧ p < uf.len ∧ uf.rank.getD i 0 < uf.rank.getD p 0 then
      spec_find uf p
    else
      i
  else
    i
termination_by measure uf i
decreasing_by sorry

  -- !benchmark @start precond
  uf.is_valid ∧

  root_j < uf.len ∧
  uf.parent.getD root_i 0 = root_i ∧ -- Input i is a root
  uf.parent.getD root_j 0 = root_j    -- Input j is a root
  -- !benchmark @end precond

    if k.val = root_i then 0 else 1

  { parent := linkParent n root_i root_j
    rank := linkRank n root_i
    len := n }
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

    (h_precond : link_roots_precond uf root_i root_j) : UnionFind :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if root_i = root_j then
    uf
  else
    linkedUF uf.len root_i root_j
  -- !benchmark @end code
